source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. An ancient royal tomb in the desert: dry wind, sand hissing on stone, mysterious and exotic, curse and grandeur. Tempo 96 BPM, 4/4 time, key of A minor. Instrumentation: oboe or ney-like reed melody with augmented seconds (phrygian dominant), oud, low drone, darbuka and frame drum, finger cymbals. Form: drone and hand drums intro, reed melody, oud interlude, melody returns. Duration: 75 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
